title: CropCop: An Auditable 120-Class Plant-Health Model from Benchmark Reconstruction to a Quantised Runtime Artifact
abstract: arXiv:2608.25539v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A plant-health score can appear precise while resting on duplicated image families, a long-tailed label space, or a runtime file that was never evaluated. We present CropCop, a closed-set recognition system spanning 120 operational plant-health classes and an evidence chain from corpus reconstruction to direct execution of the final quantised artifact. Starting from 117,546 audited images, we rejected the inherited partition after confirming 3,233 duplicate relationships across split boundaries and froze a 109,107-image benchmark with zero crossings among the audited trusted leakage groups and a 151.7 largest-to-smallest class ratio. A fully fine-tuned DINOv3 ConvNeXt-Tiny reference achieved 98.51% accuracy and 96.87% macro-F1 on the locked internal test. A compact MobileNetV4 Conv-Medium derivative achieved 98.46% accuracy and 96.27% macro-F1 without being presented as evidence for a new distillation method. Validation-only post-train

translated_title: CropCop：从基准重建到量化运行时工件的可审计120类植物健康模型
translated_abstract: 植物健康评分看似精确，但可能依赖于重复的图像族、长尾标签空间或从未被评估的运行时文件。我们提出了CropCop，一个覆盖120个操作植物健康类别的闭集识别系统，并提供了从语料库重建到最终量化工件直接执行的完整证据链。从117,546张审计图像出发，我们在确认跨分割边界的3,233个重复关系后，拒绝了继承的分区，并冻结了一个109,107张图像的基准，该基准在审计的可信泄漏组之间零交叉，最大与最小类别比为151.7。一个完全微调的DINOv3 ConvNeXt-Tiny参考模型在锁定的内部测试中达到了98.51%的准确率和96.87%的宏F1分数。一个紧凑的MobileNetV4 Conv-Medium衍生模型达到了98.46%的准确率和96.27%的宏F1分数，且未作为新蒸馏方法的证据呈现。仅验证后训练被采用。
tldr: 本文提出CropCop系统，通过严格的基准重建和量化工件直接执行，实现了120类植物健康分类的高精度识别，并提供了完整的可审计证据链。
en_tdlr: This paper presents CropCop, a system achieving high-accuracy plant-health classification across 120 classes via rigorous benchmark reconstruction and direct execution of quantized artifacts, with a complete auditable evidence chain.
